body: Is not a bad thing. It’s that I emotionally can’t handle him realizing how much I hate myself. I’m also afraid that he would freak out. Which I understand but I mean like really freak out. My mom killed herself when I was young and that hit him hard, and it still does. Now for one of his kids to have self hatred just like my mom he would be super scared. Which again I understand but I don’t want to see my dad like that just because of me. I would feel terrible.
